name: B. Acoustic focusing
description: A 16-element linear array, first with all elements in phase, then focused by phase on a target: the same hardware, a different field.
audience: acoustic engineers, ultrasound and haptics designers
expected: after focusing, the field maximum lies at the target
the focused peak pressure is several times the uniform one

story.problem: Concentrate ultrasound at a chosen point (haptics, levitation, sensing) with a fixed array.
story.configure: A focus target 5 cm in front of the array, then the focusing command (phase control).
story.calculate: The element phases that make the waves arrive in phase at the target, and the pressure field before and after.
story.meaning: Uniform excitation makes a broad beam; focusing makes a tight, much stronger spot where the target is.
story.inspect: The field in decibels on the plane, and the Field Analysis summary (peak, focal size) of each result.
story.value: The phases are calculated, not guessed, and the result is checked by a field calculation of the whole array.
story.assumptions: Free field, omnidirectional point-source elements, phase control at one frequency (40 kHz).
